Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by introducing an irrelevant comparison “relative to each film’s release year,” which is not what the question asks (it simply requires comparing directors’ death dates). This conceptual misframing, combined with subsequent redundant instructions to re-search “Giorgio Gentili death date” despite results clearly referring to a Baroque composer, stalled progress and risked leading to an incorrect or unresolved conclusion instead of synthesizing the already sufficient, verified data (Paul L. Stein died in 1951; Stanley Prager died in 1972).
